## Landings by species (tons) in SPRFMO area.

```{r, results = "asis",echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, eval = T}
cl2 %>% 
  filter(Area == "87") %>% 
  group_by(CLvesselFlagCountry, Species2) %>% 
  summarise(LandingWeight_ton = round(sum(CLscientificWeight_ton))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(LandingWeight_ton2 = ifelse(LandingWeight_ton<1, '<1', paste(LandingWeight_ton))) %>% 
  select(CLvesselFlagCountry, Species2, LandingWeight_ton2) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = CLvesselFlagCountry, values_from = LandingWeight_ton2, values_fill = '') %>% 
  arrange(Species2)-> annex2_3

kable(annex2_3)
write_csv(annex2_3, paste(table_dir,'SPRFMO_landings_country_species.csv',
                      sep = ""))
```
